source: hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki boss pages (Revenant_Horror, Tarantula_Broodfather, Sven_Packmaster, Voidgloom_Seraph, Inferno_Demonlord), Spawning tables, fetched 2026-11-24 (after the 0.27.2 change to Combat XP required)
note: Primary is the boss's slayer XP. Each boss needs this much Combat XP from mobs before it spawns, so Combat XP per slayer XP = Combat XP required / slayer XP for the tier the rate bracket assumes (rate-defaults slayerXp: early T3, mid T4, late T5, or T4 where T5 is missing or Alpha-only). XP from the boss kill itself is not counted, so these are floors.
